1.

Thou art worthy of praise and thanksgiving, Of honour and of glory. Of Thee, O Lamb of God, who wast slain, Our song shall be unto eternity.

2.

Thou sittest now upon the Father’s throne In the light and splendour of glory; There upon Thy heart Thou dost bear us In the power of love and life.

3.

To Thee we now raise our song. Though the tribute be small, indeed. No mortal tongue can express Thy full worth, Jesus Christ.

4.

Yet shalt Thou have a higher praise, When once in the clouds Thou shalt appear; Then shall we in perfect measure Render Thee, O Christ, our homage.
